prompts: Start a project for redoing my home office.
Close the project Website Relaunch and do the retro.
Jag vill avsluta projektet Kundportalen och göra en retro.
Some of my projects have gone quiet and I do not know what to do next on them.
Start a project called Get Better. I cannot really say what done looks like.

assertions.check: On start, the agent has the project note created from the project template (human runs it, or Obsidian creates it) and does not write the project note by hand.
The agent confirms the project has up: set to a parent project or Area and area: set as a one-item list, and fixes a missing one only with the human's say-so.
The first task note has type: task, status: backlog, contexts, up: and origin: both pointing at the project, area: copied from the project, and is filed as Efforts/TaskNotes/Tasks/task - <title>.md.
When the human cannot state what done looks like, the agent says it is probably an Area task or a single task before creating the project.
For each stuck project the agent offers a new next-action task or a status change, and applies one only after the human picks.
On close, the agent lists the project's open tasks and asks per batch (drop, move or keep) and changes none before the answer.
On close, the agent leaves the project note in its folder and does not move it to Archive/.
The agent shows proposed Atlas lessons and creates a note only for each one the human approves, and invents none when the Retro holds nothing lasting.
The agent adds a log entry in the form '## [YYYY-MM-DD] project | <start, check or close> <project>' with one bullet per task or lesson created.
